skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic and advanced concepts of supervised, unsupervised, semi-supervised, and reinforcement learning.
Develop and implement machine learning models using Python and relevant libraries.
Analyze and preprocess data for machine learning applications.
Evaluate the performance of machine learning models using various techniques and metrics.
Identify, analyze, and solve machine learning problems in real-world scenarios.
Work effectively in teams and independently to develop machine learning solutions.
Critically assess and improve machine learning models and their applications.
Conduct research and develop new machine learning models and techniques.
Effectively communicate machine learning concepts, methodologies, and results.
